ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_FACTTRUSTFUNDVALUE] AS
BEGIN

WITH CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
SELECT BUB.CustomerAccountId,  COUNT(InternalCustomerId) CNT FROM [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN (SELECT InternalCustomerId,BaseAccountId FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedBaseAccount) BCRB ON BUB.BaseAccountId = BCRB.BaseAccountId
GROUP BY BUB.CustomerAccountId 
)

, DW_FACTTRUSTFUNDVALUE AS (

-- UITF --
SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BUB.BalanceTimestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
 ,-1 AS BranchSK
 ,DDK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount AS AUMAmountFull
 ,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount/CASE WHEN CAP.CNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE CAP.CNT END AS AUMAmountProrated
 ,BUB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
from [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA	ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
--LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB	ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID aND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDK 	ON BUB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA		ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
--LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerRelatedBaseAccount] BCBA	ON BUB.BaseAccountId = BCBA.BaseAccountId --- NO BaseAccountId field in BNKM.CustomerAccount
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation CAP ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = CAP.CustomerAccountId
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
BUB.BalanceTimestamp
,DDK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount
,CAP.CNT
,BUB.SourceSystemCode


UNION ALL


-- NonUITF --
SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BUB.BalanceTimestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
 ,-1 AS BranchSK
 ,DDK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BUB.BalanceAmount AS AUMAmountFull
 ,BUB.BalanceAmount/CASE WHEN CAP.CNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE CAP.CNT END AS AUMAmountProrated
 ,BUB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM [BNKM].[NonUITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA	ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
--LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB	ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDK 	ON BUB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA		ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
--LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerRelatedBaseAccount] BCBA	ON BCA.BaseAccountId = BCBA.BaseAccountId --- NO BaseAccountId field in BNKM.CustomerAccount
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation CAP ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = CAP.CustomerAccountId
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
BUB.BalanceTimestamp
,DDK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BUB.BalanceAmount
,CAP.CNT
,BUB.SourceSystemCode
)

INSERT INTO [DW].[FactTrustFundValue]

SELECT DISTINCT
 BusinessDateSK
 ,BranchSK
 ,BankSK
 ,AccountSK
 ,AccountId
 ,SUM(AUMAmountFull)
 ,SUM(AUMAmountProrated)
 ,SourceSystemCode
 ,WorkFlowId
 ,TaskRunId
 ,InsertDttm
FROM DW_FACTTRUSTFUNDVALUE
GROUP BY
 BusinessDateSK
 ,BranchSK
 ,BankSK
 ,AccountSK
 ,AccountId
 ,SourceSystemCode
 ,WorkFlowId
 ,TaskRunId
 ,InsertDttm

END
GO
